title: A Little Small?
text: A Little Small?. I broke my tailbone in high school, so now that I'm in my late 40s, I'm feeling it!  With all the working from a computer, I find that my tailbone sets off my sciatica.  This has helped a lot with that.  One drawback is that it's a bit of a smaller seat, so in my office chair, it stands out.  It still works just fine and does what it needs to though.  That has been really helpful!
